summary: A parent boarding in {place} tells the driver how many people they are paying for before tapping the card.
realLife: RideKC told passengers paying for companions to tell the operator the group size first so the reader could be set for multiple fares.
gates: A carrier permits one payer to cover a group and publishes the boarding procedure.
